commitResults.messageBody: Move command input, welcome and goodbye screens, separators, indentation, task rendering, and task-count messaging into a dedicated Ui class. Keep Herta focused on command dispatch and task behavior while preserving the existing console contract, including EOF handling.

Move task-file loading, strict UTF-8 reading, storage parsing, serialization validation, and atomic saves out of Herta into a dedicated Storage class. Delegate startup loading and all persisted task mutations through one Storage instance while preserving existing command behavior and error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract user command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition, task construction, date and time validation, query arguments, sort validation, and task-number parsing into Parser. Rename Storage.parseTask to parseStoredTask to distinguish serialized-data parsing from user-command parsing, while preserving all existing UI behavior and error messages.

Introduce TaskList as the owner of task storage, indexed lookup, add/remove operations, completion-state updates, rollback support, matching, and stable sorted indices. Update Herta and Storage to exchange TaskList instead of raw mutable lists while preserving task numbering, persistence behavior, and console output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract exit handling into command hierarchy
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the abstract Command contract with execute and isExit operations, then implement ExitCommand for the bye flow. Extend Parser with an incremental command-object parsing seam and update Herta to execute migrated commands while retaining legacy dispatch for the remaining command types. Preserve all existing console behavior and error handling so the stretch-goal refactor can proceed safely in small steps.

Move task-list display behavior from Herta into a concrete ListCommand that follows the shared Command execution contract. Extend Parser.parse to create ListCommand instances while preserving legacy dispatch for commands that have not yet migrated. Keep list output, task ordering, and persistence behavior unchanged so the command hierarchy can continue to grow incrementally.

Introduce AddCommand as the shared base for commands that append tasks, including persistence-before-mutation and confirmation output. Implement TodoCommand and extend Parser.parse to construct it from validated todo input, removing todo handling from Herta's legacy switch. Preserve existing validation, storage error handling, and console output while preparing deadline and event commands to reuse the same add workflow.

Implement DeadlineCommand as an AddCommand specialization so deadline tasks use the shared persistence, task-list update, and confirmation workflow. Extend Parser.parse to construct DeadlineCommand instances from validated deadline input and remove deadline handling from Herta's legacy switch. Preserve all existing date validation, storage behavior, and console output while continuing the incremental command migration.

Implement EventCommand as the final AddCommand specialization so todo, deadline, and event additions share one execution path for persistence, task-list updates, and confirmation output. Extend Parser.parse to construct EventCommand instances from validated event input and remove the obsolete add helper and event branch from Herta. Preserve event date validation, range checks, storage behavior, and all existing console output.

Introduce TaskIndexCommand to centralize validation of selected task indices and implement DeleteCommand for persistent task removal. Extend Parser.parse to construct DeleteCommand instances from validated delete input, and remove deletion behavior from Herta's legacy switch and helper. Preserve one-based task handling, invalid-input messages, persistence ordering, task numbering, and console output.

Move completion-status mutations, persistence rollback, and user feedback out of Herta and into dedicated MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand classes. Extend Parser command construction for both commands while reusing TaskIndexCommand validation, leaving the interactive behavior unchanged.

Move filtering, upcoming-task lookup, and chronological sorting out of Herta into FilterCommand, UpcomingCommand, and SortCommand. Add QueryCommand to share result rendering for predicate-based queries, and update Parser to construct the new command objects while preserving validation and user-visible output.

Add UnknownCommand so blank and unrecognised inputs are represented in the command hierarchy. Change Parser.parse to return a concrete Command for every input and remove Optional-based fallback dispatch from Herta while preserving all existing error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Herta into an application object
commitResults.messageBody: Move Ui, Storage, Parser, and TaskList into Herta fields, load tasks through the constructor, and expose a run method for the command loop. Keep main as a thin launcher and preserve startup errors, EOF handling, separators, and exit behavior while aligning the entry point with the target OOP design.
